title: What if the Sun vanished right now? ☀️
subject: sun
description:
What would actually happen to Earth if the Sun disappeared? The answer starts with an 8-minute delay.

Sources: NASA, Live Science

scenes.text: If the Sun vanished right now, you wouldn't notice for 8 minutes and 20 seconds.
That's how long sunlight takes to reach us, and even gravity travels at that same speed.
So Earth would keep circling an empty point in space, then fly off in a straight line into the dark.
The sky goes black, and the Moon disappears too, because it only shines with reflected sunlight.
Within a week, the average temperature would drop below 0 degrees Fahrenheit. Within a year, minus 100.
Plants would stop growing almost instantly, and most would die within weeks.
The oceans would freeze from the top down, but deep below the ice, warmed by Earth's core, the water could stay liquid for thousands of years.
Life might survive down there, in total darkness. Would you want to be one of them?
